title: Detailed tent
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='tentBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#f39c12'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#d35400'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='roofL' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#e67e22'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#b9591d'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='roofR' x1='1' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#e67e22'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#b9591d'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='89' rx='40' ry='5' fill='#5b3a1a' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- left roof panel -->
  <polygon points='50,14 12,86 50,86' fill='url(#roofL)'/>
  <!-- right roof panel -->
  <polygon points='50,14 88,86 50,86' fill='url(#roofR)'/>

  <!-- roof ridge highlight -->
  <line x1='50' y1='14' x2='50' y2='86' stroke='#fde3a7' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- left stitching line -->
  <line x1='33' y1='30' x2='28' y2='86' stroke='#f1c27d' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-dasharray='4 3'/>
  <!-- right stitching line -->
  <line x1='67' y1='30' x2='72' y2='86' stroke='#f1c27d' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-dasharray='4 3'/>

  <!-- left roof seam highlight -->
  <line x1='50' y1='14' x2='12' y2='86' stroke='#f7c873' stroke-width='1.2' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- right roof seam highlight -->
  <line x1='50' y1='14' x2='88' y2='86' stroke='#f7c873' stroke-width='1.2' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- entrance opening (dark inside) -->
  <polygon points='50,44 33,86 67,86' fill='#4a1f0a'/>
  <!-- inner tent glow -->
  <polygon points='50,52 38,86 62,86' fill='#7a3a14'/>

  <!-- rolled back flap left -->
  <polygon points='50,44 33,86 40,86 54,48' fill='#f1c27d'/>
  <!-- rolled back flap right -->
  <polygon points='50,44 67,86 60,86 46,48' fill='#e8b06a'/>

  <!-- tied flap knot left -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='50' r='3' fill='#f5deb3'/>
  <!-- tied flap knot right -->
  <circle cx='55' cy='50' r='3' fill='#f5deb3'/>

  <!-- ridge peak cap -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='3' fill='#fde3a7'/>

  <!-- guy line pegs left -->
  <line x1='12' y1='86' x2='6' y2='91' stroke='#fde3a7' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='12' y1='86' x2='4' y2='87' stroke='#fde3a7' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- guy line pegs right -->
  <line x1='88' y1='86' x2='94' y2='91' stroke='#fde3a7' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='88' y1='86' x2='96' y2='87' stroke='#fde3a7' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- entrance ground trim -->
  <rect x='33' y='85' width='34' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#8e5a1f'/>
</svg>
